author: Discovery
description:
Rainy conditions push survivalists to their limits, soaking shelters, ruining firewood, and turning harsh environments into muddy, morale-draining struggles as they battle nonstop Amazon downpours to survive.
#Discovery #NakedandAfraid

Stream Full Episodes of Naked and Afraid:
https://www.discovery.com/shows/naked-and-afraid
About Naked and Afraid:
What happens when you put two strangers - sans clothes - in some of the most extreme environments on Earth? Each male-female duo is left with no food, no water, no clothes, and only one survival item each as they attempt to survive on their own.
